title: 3D city map
intent: Represent store metrics as building heights and category intersections as districts, with an interactive 3D surface and a semantic top-view preview.

ai.create: Render store metrics as buildings in category-intersection districts using the city renderer and the existing React chart contracts.
ai.maintain: Preserve datum identity, metric heights, category districts, keyboard selection, camera controls, renderer disposal, and the source-backed catalog entry.
